items.prompt: Derive a second exact formula and explain what changes if dice are not independent.
items.modelAnswer: Tail sum E[X]=sum P(X>=r) follows by counting m ones for outcome m. Under independence, tail is 1-((r-1)/k)^n. Coupled dice need the joint distribution, not this product. Compare small tuple enumeration and exact fractions.
